name: stray-close
title: Close of unknown descriptor
fix_goal: Cleanup should only release descriptors that this function successfully acquired.
fix_steps: Initialize descriptor variables to -1 before acquisition.
Only call p101_close when the descriptor is not -1.
Do not close arbitrary integers or sentinel values.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the stray-close lab is fixed.
lesson: Cleanup should only release resources that were successfully acquired.
